Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with TestSTT (TTS->STT round-trip returns 200 with transcribed text; unauth returns 401) and TestDaily (GET /daily, submit, duplicate=400 'Already', reload done). Full suite: 29/29 pytest passed. Frontend: seeded auth via /api/auth/register + localStorage lv_token, granted mic+camera permissions, then verified Dashboard daily-challenge card end-to-end (start->select opt->submit->daily-result 'Correct! +25 XP' + '1-day streak' -> reload shows daily-done); Tutor page mic-btn renders and toggles to recording state (rose + animate-pulse classes) with text streaming still working (GPT streamed 'four' for '2+2'); Mock Interview start-interview-btn -> video-stage with AI orb + webcam-video element + replay-question-btn + mic-btn all render, Q1 loads, TTS auto-speaks (Speaking… indicator observed), submit-answer-btn -> next Q2 loaded with 6/10 score and feedback in log. Regression: dashboard stat-xp/stat-streak render.
critical_code_review_comments: Login/Register form inputs lack data-testid (only placeholders). Recommend adding data-testid="register-name/email/password/mobile" and "login-email/password" + submit buttons for stable automation.

DailyChallenge submit called with `selected` state; on timer expiry it correctly uses selectedRef, but user-triggered submit uses stale closure if the answer callback is invoked from inside setInterval. Verified working via ref pattern, but consider unifying to a single ref-based submit for consistency.
Interview page toast 'Failed to start' swallows the underlying error — surface e.response?.data?.detail for better UX/debugging.

TTS URL construction in Interview.js uses `process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + res.data.url` — if REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL has trailing slash it will produce '//api/tts/...'. Currently OK but brittle; consider using axios baseURL or URL join.
server.py now 970 lines; STT + Daily added to same monolith. Split into routers (auth/chat/tts/quiz/friends/interview/daily/media).
